name: Milan
tagline: A 1949 panzerotto by the Duomo, and two Michelin stars that have defined Milanese haute cuisine for half a century.

Cracco in Galleria.description: Carlo Cracco's table inside the Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II, in the heart of Milan. One Michelin star.

Aimo e Nadia.description: A Milanese haute cuisine institution for more than half a century. Two Michelin stars.

Luini.description: The bakery that introduced the Puglian panzerotto to Milan, since 1949, steps from the Duomo.

Seta by Antonio Guida.description: Antonio Guida's cuisine at the Mandarin Oriental Milano, Mediterranean technique of the highest precision. Two Michelin stars.

Enrico Bartolini al MUDEC.description: Inside the Museum of Cultures, Milan's only three-Michelin-star table.
